```{r}
#| label: setup
scratch_file <- if (file.exists(".heather_scratch_objects.rds")) {
  ".heather_scratch_objects.rds"
} else {
  "ons/.heather_scratch_objects.rds"
}
if (!file.exists(scratch_file)) {
  stop("Run 'ons/additional_analysis.R' after Sarah's scripts, then render this QMD.")
}
scratch <- readRDS(scratch_file)
```

#| label: patient-flow-icb
